release of Potassium, which is vital for building superior soil quality.

penetrate deeper and establish a stronger grip.

4. Root Development: Actively supports and accelerates robust root growth.

Vegetable Crops: Mix 2.5 ml per Liter of water.
Fruit Crops: Mix 1 Liter per 200 Liters of water.

Time of Application:

Mid-Cycle: It can also be applied during the crop production cycle to enhance the availability of manure and
nutrients to the plants.
